strings.en: The Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit is a multifunctional toolkit specifically designed for handheld props, combining lighting, sound, and motion-sensing controls to deliver a personalized, immersive experience. Featuring high-brightness LED strips paired with diffused pearl cotton, it offers smooth and natural lighting effects. An integrated speaker cavity ensures clear audio quality, while the built-in IMU motion sensor captures real-time movements, triggering corresponding light and sound effects for actions like turning on/off, swinging, thrusting, or striking.

context.title: Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit
context.near: Introduction

strings.en: The Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit offers two configurations: Kit 01 (Complete Set with LED strips, aluminum alloy tubes, and diffused pearl cotton for large-scale props like the Golden Staff) and Kit 02 (Compact Edition requiring user-provided LED light strip 256RGB 5050LED 815MM, optimized for swords/daggers). Unlike purely aesthetic prop sets that lack hardware, this kit is more than just a prop—it's your creative partner. It supports extensive customization across appearance, lighting effects, and sound effects, compatible with various prop forms such as Golden Staff, Double-Bladed Weapon, and Pixel Lightsaber. Leveraging 3D printing and professional design, it unlocks limitless possibilities for your imagination. With app connectivity, users can easily adjust light colors, flashing frequencies, and even upload custom sound and light effects, creating a one-of-a-kind, personalized prop with ease.
